summary: Iter 24 — focused regression on the two NEW features shipped this session: (A) AI Quant Analyst terminal in the Research Lab -> Analytics Engine quadrant modal and (B) Saved Configs panel + schema-driven dynamic parameter editor in the Research Lab -> Strategy Validation quadrant modal. Backend: 8/8 GREEN in new /app/backend/tests/test_iter24_ai_analyst_and_configs.py — GET /api/strategy/registry returns all 3 strategies each with a valid params schema (id/type/default/group/label); GET /api/strategy/configs list OK; POST /api/strategy/configs creates a user config; PUT /api/strategy/configs/{id} accepts sparse param overrides, out-of-range params return 422 with {errors: [...]}, rating.stars and name update in the same PUT; DELETE /api/strategy/configs/{id} removes a user config; DELETE on origin='builtin' returns 400 as designed; POST /api/analytics/ai_query returns 400 on empty question; returns {session_id, answer} on a real question (grounded on the ledger — verified the answer mentions actual numbers); multi-turn: same session_id preserved across turns; unauth POST (direct urllib bypass of conftest patch) is 401 (owner-gate honoured). Iter23 regression re-run: 10/10 GREEN (test_iter23_cockpit.py) — cockpit 2x2 grid, kill-switch toggle, /api/settings persistence, from-lab-run bridge all still working. Web UI (owner logged in via localStorage token, viewport 1920x1080): Research Lab tab -> quad-analytics opens analytics-modal with ai-analyst-terminal + 4 ai-suggestion buttons + enabled input. Sent 2 real questions through the UI — turn 1: 'How many closed trades are in the snapshot?' -> assistant answered '16 closed trades are in the snapshot.' (grounded number). Turn 2 (multi-turn): 'Now which strategy contributed most of those?' -> assistant answered '**Hunter** — it was the executing strategy on 9 of the 12 trades...' (i.e., it correctly referred back to the count from turn 1, proving session continuity). Closed modal, opened validation-modal via quad-validation: saved-configs-panel renders 3 saved-group-* sections each with a create-config-* NEW button (all enabled for owner). Created a new Hunter user config -> rows went 6->7, config-editor-* auto-expanded exposing 22 param-input-* fields across all 4 groups Entry/Filters/Risk/Time (plus Exit sub-group visible), including ON/OFF bool selects. Rating: star-3 click persisted (verified visually + via API in backend test). Save: changed a numeric param 30->31 and clicked config-save-* -> toast 'CONFIG SAVED · 1 override(s)' (sparse-diff logic works — only the changed field went into the payload). Cleanup: deleted the freshly-created user config, rows back to 6 (delete count = 4 of 7 rows = 3 builtin correctly hide delete button). Kill switch confirmed OFF at end of run. Total 3 LLM calls consumed in AI analyst (2 UI + 1 grounded backend test; multi-turn test itself is 2 calls; empty & owner-gate tests short-circuit before LLM).

issues: Layout/spacing looks good at 1920px. Assistant bubbles use monospaced text at ~12px; wraps cleanly. Suggestion grid is 2-column and readable. No contrast issues observed.

design_issues.screen: Strategy Validation modal — Saved Configs editor
issues: Schema-driven grid (2 columns) renders 22 params cleanly across Entry/Filters/Risk/Time/Exit. Bool params correctly render as ON/OFF selects. 'override' badge next to any field whose value differs from default is a nice touch. SAVE PARAMS toast confirms exact override count.

action_items: (Nice-to-have) ConfigEditor.useEffect dep list is [cfg.id, schema] — re-inits only when the row changes or the schema swaps, which is intentional; but if a config's persisted params change externally (e.g. from another tab) after mount, the editor won't re-hydrate. Consider watching cfg.params too, or use a stable key.

(Nice-to-have) After config-save-*, toast description shows the count but the editor stays in its current state; the parent onSaved callback correctly replaces the row in the configs list, but the local `vals` state won't reset to the new server-side params (harmless in normal flow since values already match, but could drift if backend normalises).

(Nice-to-have) When AI analyst returns a very short/empty answer, the UI still renders an ai-msg-assistant bubble — consider surfacing 'no answer' state distinctly. Not observed in practice; all runs returned solid answers.
(Carry-over from iter23) StrategyValidationPanel.jsx still >1000 lines — split into sibling files for RunRow/RunDetails/TradeLog/SaveConfigDialog when time permits.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py::analytics_ai_query correctly generates a session_id when the client omits it, and reuses the caller-supplied session_id for multi-turn — matches AIAnalystTerminal.ask() which stores it in sessionRef.current. Persistence into ai_analyst_messages via insert_many is atomic per-turn (user + assistant together), good for replay.

ai_analyst.py::_gather_context caps reasoning=25 and trades=30 rows so prompt tokens stay bounded even as the DB grows. Fallback to open trades when no closed exist is a nice touch. Aggregate stats (win_rate/total_pnl) are pre-computed and injected — the LLM answered 'closed trades = 16' consistent with the AGGREGATE line, confirming grounding is working.

server.py::strategy_update_config correctly re-validates params against schema on every PUT — proved by 422 test with detail.errors[]. It also allows rating/name/parent_config_id/validation_status in the same PUT, matching what the UI sends (rating.stars from Stars.onSet).

SavedConfigsPanel::ConfigEditor.save() sends only the sparse diff (v != default) — verified the toast said '1 override(s)' when we changed exactly one field. This keeps the strategy inheritance chain clean and avoids polluting overrides with re-typed defaults.

The delete button is correctly hidden for origin='builtin' rows (verified: 3 builtin rows have no delete btn, 4 non-builtin rows do). Backend also enforces 400 on delete of builtin, so UI + API are aligned defense-in-depth.
